second_opinion.note: D66 (operator, 2026-10-25): spend ceiling $5 in total; TypeSafe price measured by the operator: 20,780 tokens over 55 requests cost $0.0008, about $0.0000145 per call. The price field takes six decimals (price_per_call_usd), so the role's price is entered rounded UP to 0.000015 (the conservative side: spend is never under-counted). Both are entered by the operator at 17.1: the classifier role's price in Settings > Endpoints, and CLASSIFIER_SPEND_CEILING_USD (agent-forbidden runtime setting, 'Money: only the operator sets it'); while either is unset every paid run is refused. These values here are the record, not the settings.
second_opinion.estimate: Four label runs (one per compared column), each at most the per-run cap of 2,500 rows: at most 10,000 calls x $0.000015 = $0.15 per full second-opinion pass; the $5 ceiling covers about 33 such passes
